275674468.description:
Educational Resource
Geological Mineral Set & Jamestown, Virginia Mineral Specimens
Natural Geological Specimens in Original Packaging
10" x 7" x 3"
Original Multi-Piece Sets
This collection includes two vintage educational mineral sets designed for the study of earth science. The primary "Geological Mineral Set" features 24 mounted specimens including unique items such as Dinosaur Bone, Petrified Wood, and Sulphur, each labeled with its classification and geographic origin. Accompanied by the "Jamestown, Virginia" set containing 12 specimens, this lot provides a comprehensive overview of common and rare minerals found throughout North America, including Obsidian, Rose Quartz, and Zinc Ore.
Includes 24-specimen Earth Science set and 12-specimen Jamestown collection
Original yellow "Guide to Rocks & Minerals" instructional booklet included
Specimens are securely mounted to identification cards with original vintage typography
Combined dimensions approximately 10" x 7" x 3" for the two boxes
Condition:
Good vintage condition. The specimens are largely intact and well-preserved on their original mounting cards. The outer boxes show age-appropriate wear, including some toning, minor staining to the teal lid, and edge rubbing typical of educational materials from the mid-20th century. The interior cards show light foxing, but all text remains clear and legible.
